claims.label: Robert Richards IV convicted in 2009 of raping his three-year-old daughter
claims.claim: Robert Richards IV was convicted in 2009 of raping his three-year-old daughter, seven years after the child reported the abuse.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain certified court records of the 2009 Delaware conviction and compare to Vanity Fair account.

claims.label: Judge Jan Jordan ruled treatment in lieu of prison for Richards IV
claims.claim: Judge Jan Jordan ruled that Robert Richards IV would benefit from treatment instead of prison time, citing his height and other factors.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the sentencing order or contemporaneous news coverage of the Jordan ruling.

claims.label: Robert H. Richards III is Richards IV's father and retired partner at Richards Layton & Finger
claims.claim: Robert H. Richards III, father of Robert Richards IV, is identified in the Vanity Fair article as a retired partner at the Richards Layton & Finger law firm.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference firm partnership records and Richards family genealogy.

claims.label: Richards IV admitted to sexually assaulting his infant son
claims.claim: Robert Richards IV also admitted to sexually assaulting his infant son and was initially charged with two counts of second-degree child rape carrying a mandatory 20-year term, before pleading to a reduced charge of fourth-degree rape.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the plea agreement and original charging documents.

claims.label: John DuPont shot Olympic wrestler David Schultz dead in 1996
claims.claim: John DuPont shot Olympic wrestler David Schultz dead in the driveway of the family mansion in 1996, per Vanity Fair account.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm against public court records of the John DuPont criminal case.

claims.label: Lisa Dean DuPont and Christopher Mosley ordered killing of Las Vegas prostitute
claims.claim: Per Vanity Fair, Lisa Dean DuPont and her husband Christopher Mosley ordered the killing of a Las Vegas prostitute whose body was found in a motel air conditioner; money traced to the DuPont family. Both DuPont and Mosley died in prison.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate contemporaneous court filings or the original Dominic Dunn Vanity Fair piece.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk wrote on April 13, 2018 about real war beyond fathoming
claims.claim: Charlie Kirk wrote on April 13, 2018: "In our lifetime, we will experience real war beyond anything that we can fathom. Absolute and total destruction."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original text record or phone screenshot for verification of exact wording.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk texted about whether to change shirt before a date
claims.claim: Charlie Kirk texted Candace Owens asking whether he had to change his shirt before a date; Owens replied "Yes, and throw it away if you can, Charlie"; Kirk replied "Ah, okay."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain screenshot of original exchange if preserved.

claims.label: Viewer theory that McRonone lawsuit was intended to pre-empt Candace's assassination
claims.claim: A viewer commented that the McRonone lawsuit was designed to go nowhere because Candace was supposed to have been assassinated before the case reached court, allowing plaintiffs to permanently claim she was lying.
claims.investigative_direction: Review litigation timing and any sealed filings in the McRonone matter.

claims.label: Multiple viewers expressed support for host in Episode 39 comments
